title: Public Env Guard
summary: Reads a .env the way the bundler does and flags secrets in public variables, so a secret key isn't shipped in the client bundle.
description: .env check that lists every NEXT_PUBLIC_, VITE_, REACT_APP_, EXPO_PUBLIC_ or PUBLIC_ variable reaching the browser and flags secret key shapes, Supabase service_role JWTs, passwords in URLs, secret names and high-entropy values, with a server-only rename.
catches: Public-prefixed variables that reach the browser, per framework
Secret key shapes (for example Stripe secret keys) in public variables
Secret-sounding names and high-entropy values, while letting publishable keys through
limits: Reads the .env text you paste; secrets set elsewhere (CI, hosting dashboard) aren't seen
High-entropy detection can flag harmless IDs
Renaming doesn't un-leak a key already shipped; rotate it
a11y: Visible label; textarea has aria-invalid when errors exist and is described by the status
Status uses role=status; icons are aria-hidden
Focus returns to a nearby control after a fix
server: Scan built bundles in CI for secrets and keep secret keys only in server-side environment variables.
stops: Helps catch a secret key shipped in the client bundle
